desc: A stout, cheerful baker: red cheeks, a brown beard, a white cap, a cream apron over a tan shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, brown trousers.
A tall, thin fortune-teller: pale, with dark eye make-up and long black hair, a deep blue robe to the ankles with a gold-striped sash, and a plum headscarf.
A farm lad with freckles and sandy hair under a wide straw hat: a mustard shirt with bare forearms, a green waistcoat, brown trousers and muddy boots.
An old night-watchman with dark brown skin and a short white beard: a long grey coat to the knees, a red scarf, a tall dark felt hat and heavy black boots.
